newsitem.title: UK: Six firms shortlisted for UK freight rail sale - FT.
newsitem.headline: Six firms shortlisted for UK freight rail sale - FT.

text.p: Six companies have been shortlisted in the bidding for Railfreight Distribution, the last of British Rail's freight businesses to be privatised, the Financial Times said in its Wednesday edition.

The FT said the bidders for the loss-making international freight services venture were Spain's Transfesa, GE Capital, National Power, English Welsh and Scottish Railway, Freightliner and Tibbett & Britten.
The paper said Railfreight Distribution has a turnover of 60 million stg a year, employs 1,500 people and operates about 160 freight trains through the Channel Tunnel each week.
It is due to be established as a separate company within the next two weeks and the sale is planned to be completed early next year, the FT added.
